name: Awaken

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

components.m: an agate worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes

targets.description: a Beast or Plant with Intelligence 3 or lower

summary: A Beast or Plant you touch gains a mind of its own and becomes friendly to you.
text: The target (Intelligence 3 or less) gets Intelligence 10 and a language you know; a Plant can also move and sense like a Beast. It is Charmed by you for 30 days or until you or your allies harm it, and decides how it feels about you afterwards.
